answer: Make identity a slashable bond. An agent registers by staking capital and one liveness check; reputation is minted only by verified work, bound to that identity, never transferable. Fresh accounts start at zero, so a farm pays bond and compute on every alias, while a cluster proven to share one controller loses all bonded value in one ruling. The identity graph is an atlas of funding paths and device prints; a clone farm is a dune of identical edges. Withdrawals stay gated until a sonnet of independent attestations confirms the work, so cost scales with identities while payoff stays flat.
